{{Quote|I understand he and the Five-Oh-First have already left with General Drask.''"<br />"''Probably gone to join up with the Vagaari attack force.|[[Dean Jinzler]] and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SQ" />}}
In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Skirmish aboard Dreadnaught-Four|attacked]] [[Vagaari Empire]] [[Supreme Commander (Vagaari)|Supreme Commander]] [[Estosh]]'s [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Dreadnaught-Four]]'', obtaining the location of a rendezvous point where Estosh was to take ''Dreadnaught-Four'' in the process. After [[Death/Legends|killing]] Estosh and his forces, Skywalker gave the location of the rendezvous to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] nation, which the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] forces had [[Battle of the Redoubt|attacked]] previously.<ref name="SQ" />

The Ascendancy and the [[Empire of the Hand]]'s [[501st Legion (Empire of the Hand)|501st Legion]] then carried out a retaliatory surprise '''attack''' on a [[Vagaari attack force]] at the rendezvous point as part of the<ref name="SQ" /> [[Third Vagaari War]].<ref name="Joiner" /> The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Prard'ras'kleoni]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Drask," and Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Chak Fel]] participated in the attack, which resulted in the Vagaari Empire [[Starship/Legends|vessels']] destruction.<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]''.<ref name="SQ" />
